title: Audit Engagement Manager - Fund & Investment Audit
description: Vanguard is hiring an Audit Engagement Manager to join our Global Investment and Financial Audit Services (GIFAS) team! In this role you will oversee risk-based audit and consulting engagements across the Investment Lifecycle, including front (investment/portfolio management), middle (investment operations), and back (fund accounting and oversight) office. You’ll play a pivotal role in implementing audit strategy on key risk topics, collaborating closely with partners to drive improvements in control environments. We seek individuals with strong critical thinking, project management, and relationship-building skills who can communicate effectively, exercise sound judgment, and influence senior stakeholders. Responsibilities: Oversee the delivery of the audit and consulting engagements. Ensure the timely delivery of the highest quality work and value-add recommendations. Assess the adequacy of the technology control environment, identify gaps and opportunities for continuous improvement based on relevant knowledge and experience. Assist in developing and communicating the objectives of an engagement to audit team, department management and business clients. Outline engagement scope, determine level of associated risk and analyze data to determine underlying root causes. Challenge established processes and controls to ensure they are adequate to mitigate risk. Perform work and analysis on complex technology areas. Communicate the status and results of assigned work to various levels of management. Influence management to act on recommendations to strengthen the control environment and make process improvements. Provide opinion on audit and consulting findings, ratings, and recommendations to management. Communicate expectations to team and provide meaningful feedback to help develop team members by identifying and communicating areas for improvement in a timely manner. Establish and maintain relationships with technology management across aligned division and risk partners. Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Minimum of five years related work experience preferably in the financial services industry, including asset management or banking. Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Advanced degree is a plus. Strong technical expertise in asset management, capital markets, and regulatory compliance is important; CIA, CPA, CFA, or FRM are preferred but not required Experience delivering internal audits, evaluating control effectiveness, and recommending improvements that support business objectives. Skilled in managing the day‑to‑day execution of audit engagements, fostering productive stakeholder relationships, and coaching junior staff. Data analytics literacy, with the ability to apply analytical techniques to extract actionable insights and drive informed decision-making. Effective communicator with strong problem-solving, documentation, and leadership skills. Special Factors Sponsorship Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. About Vanguard At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission. To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best. How We Work Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Internal Audit Practices Quality Specialist
description: Vanguard’s Internal Audit & SOX (IAS) department is seeking an Internal Audit Practices Quality Specialist to join the Center for Audit Practices and Enablement (CAPE) team. CAPE provides leading practices and services related to audit methodology, quality assurance, training and development, and audit operations. In this role, you will execute and/or manage portions of the Internal Audit Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) and support initiatives requiring audit and risk management expertise, including maintaining audit methodology and assisting with annual audit planning. You will also contribute to the development and delivery of guidance and training to Internal Audit teams globally. Responsibilities: Conduct independent quality assessments of Internal Audit activities to evaluate adherence to methodology and professional standards, identify improvement opportunities, and reduce audit risk. Support the development and ongoing maintenance of audit methodology and quality assurance programs, including benchmarking against professional standards, regulatory expectations, and leading practices. Contribute to departmental strategic initiatives that impact or are impacted by IAS methodology by performing analysis, drafting materials, and working cross-collaboratively to ensure methodology and practices are aligned with industry standards. Assist with annual audit planning activities, including data gathering, analysis, and creation of reporting to assist management with development of the annual plan; where applicable, use data analytics and automation to improve outcomes; help promote consistent application of planning methodology across audit teams. Serve as a technical resource to audit teams by helping interpret professional standards, explaining methodology updates, and reinforcing how changes improve audit quality and outcomes; drive enhanced outcomes and insights through effective partnerships across IAS teams. Support the development and delivery of guidance and training, including written methodology materials and learning sessions for Internal Audit teams globally. Maintain awareness of industry trends and developments by participating in professional organizations, leveraging internal and external networks, and sharing relevant insights with CAPE teammates and the broader IAS organization. Participate in special projects and other department initiatives, as assigned. Qualifications: Minimum of five years work experience in internal audit, risk or controls, preferably with exposure to audit execution and understanding of audit lifecycle and standards required. Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Experience applying or interpreting audit methodology or professional standards (e.g., IIA standards, internal audit frameworks, QAIP exposure), including evaluating audit quality or supporting methodology evolution required. Demonstrated ability to work across stakeholders and contribute to audit-related initiatives, such as quality reviews, annual planning, or methodology/guidance development required. This is a hybrid role — candidates must be commutable to Vanguard's Malvern, PA office. CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), or other relevant certification preferred. What you'll do Work directly with the Bosch Rexroth Japan leadership team on strategy and organizational development. Support the development of our country strategy, from purpose, vision and strategic objectives to initiatives, KPIs and execution. Turn management discussions and ideas into clear concepts, presentations, decision papers and actionable plans. Support the deployment of strategy across the organization, including workshops, alignment with departments, consolidation of input and follow-up. Prepare and facilitate leadership workshops and strategic meetings, including agendas, materials, documentation and action tracking. Help develop management routines, meeting structures, review cycles and long-term leadership agendas. Conduct research and analysis to support strategic decisions and management discussions. Coordinate cross-functional strategic initiatives and follow up with stakeholders across the organization. Help ensure that decisions become actions by maintaining transparency on priorities, responsibilities, deadlines and progress. Why join us This is a unique opportunity to experience how a company is actually led from the inside. Rather than supporting one department or a single project, you will work closely with our senior management team and gain exposure to strategy, organizational development, governance and business transformation across the entire company. You will be expected to take complex and sometimes unstructured management topics and help turn them into something tangible: a presentation, analysis, workshop, management process, project plan or decision proposal. The role therefore combines elements of strategy consulting, project management and a leadership-team office. You will receive significant exposure to senior management while being trusted with real responsibility and work that directly influences how Bosch Rexroth Japan develops. Qualifications Upper-Intermediate English required Upper-Intermediate Japanese preferred You should... Be able to stay for a period of minimum 6 months, preferably longer. Be enrolled at a university throughout the internship period. Be willing to work in a hybrid environment (office and home office). Be comfortable working directly with senior leaders in an international environment. Enjoy turning complex and ambiguous topics into clear, structured outputs. What we're looking for Highly structured, analytical and intellectually curious. Excellent PowerPoint skills and the ability to communicate complex ideas simply and visually. Strong analytical skills, including confidence working with Excel and business data. Proactive and independent working style with a high level of ownership. Strong project management and organizational skills. Comfortable following up with senior stakeholders and driving topics forward. Discreet and professional when working with confidential management topics. Good command of English and ability to communicate effectively in an international environment. Preferred Background in business, strategy, economics, engineering, organizational development or a related field. MBA or Master's students are particularly welcome. Experience working in Japan is a plus. Previous professional experience in consulting, strategy, project management, a CEO/management office, or similar roles are a plus. We are open to candidates with previous professional experience who have returned to university for an MBA, Master's or other advanced degree.

description: As the Product Owner for our internal MS-SQL database, you will take end-to-end responsibility for our transport analytics products. title: Business Controller
description: Jouw rol: de financiële sparringpartner van de business Als Business Controller rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CFO. Je bent de financiële partner voor de Business Line Managers en helpt hen de relatie te leggen tussen: commerciële ambities projectresultaten serviceprestaties capaciteit kosten en rendement strategische keuzes Je maakt complexe informatie concreet voor mensen die niet dagelijks met financiën werken. Goede business control gaat hier niet alleen over cijfers. Het gaat over begrijpen wat erachter zit en op tijd handelen. Waarom deze rol anders is: Dit is geen functie waarin je alleen rapportages maakt. Je zit dicht op de operatie en bent betrokken bij de keuzes die bepalen hoe Bosch presteert. Je werkt met: project- en serviceorganisaties technische en commerciële teams Business Line Managers projectcontrollers de CFO collega’s in Duitsland en binnen Bosch Je analyseert niet alleen afwijkingen, maar stelt ook de vraag: Wat moeten we nu doen om het resultaat te verbeteren? De context waarin jij werkt. Je standplaats is bij voorkeur Berkel en Rodenrijs, waar belangrijke financiële en operationele kennis van AFAS aanwezig is. Tegelijkertijd heeft Bosch ook een vestiging in Nieuwegein. Heb je een duidelijke voorkeur voor Nieuwegein? Dan bespreken we graag hoe we dit passend kunnen maken. In eerste instantie werk je voor een groot deel vanuit de gekozen hoofdlocatie om de organisatie, systemen en collega’s goed te leren kennen. Daarna ontstaat meer flexibiliteit voor hybride werken. Het inwerktraject wordt zorgvuldig ingericht. De huidige interim Business Controller en de CFO zorgen samen voor een uitgebreide overdracht en blijven beschikbaar voor vragen tijdens jouw eerste periode. Je begint dus niet alleen. Je krijgt begeleiding van mensen die de organisatie en financiële processen goed kennen. Jouw impact: Van financiële data naar duidelijke besluiten Planning en budgettering Begeleiden van het jaarlijkse budgetproces Ondersteunen van meerjarenplannen Opstellen en verbeteren van financiële modellen Vertalen van de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete financiële doelstellingen Forecasting en resultaatbewaking Opstellen en onderhouden van doorlopende prognoses Analyseren van omzet, kosten, winstgevendheid en werkkapitaal Vergelijken van werkelijke resultaten met budget en prognose Verklaren van afwijkingen en signaleren van oorzaken Ontwikkelen van vroege signaleringen voor risico’s en kansen Analyse en rapportage Opstellen van heldere managementrapportages Maken van dashboards en stuurinformatie Uitvoeren van analyses voor project- en serviceorganisaties Benoemen van verbeterkansen en concrete vervolgstappen Ondersteunen van de CFO en het management met betrouwbare inzichten Business partnering en verbetering Fungeren als financieel sparringpartner voor Business Line Managers Vertalen van financiële informatie naar begrijpelijke acties Bevorderen van financieel bewustzijn in de organisatie Verbeteren van processen en datakwaliteit Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële systemen en hulpmiddelen Jij zorgt dat de organisatie niet alleen weet wat er gebeurt, maar ook begrijpt waarom. Wat jij meebrengt: Must-haves Bachelor in Finance, Accountancy, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in controlling, financiële analyse of planning Ervaring met project- of servicegerichte organisaties Gevorderde kennis van Excel Ervaring met ERP-systemen, bij voorkeur AFAS Nederlands is je eerste taal of je beheerst het vloeiend. De beheersing van het Engels is een vereiste. Sterk gewenst Ervaring met Power BI of vergelijkbare hulpmiddelen Ervaring in system integration, bouw of technische dienstverlening Kennis van projectresultaten, onderhanden werk en margesturing Inzicht in Nederlandse verslaggevingsregels Ervaring met het verbeteren van financiële processen Wie jij bent. Je ziet verbanden in complexe gegevens Je durft kritisch door te vragen Je communiceert helder Je bent zelfstandig en proactief Je werkt zorgvuldig en betrouwbaar Je kunt schakelen tussen detail en grote lijn Je krijgt energie van verbetering Jij bent niet iemand die alleen met cijfers werkt. Jij maakt cijfers waardevol voor mensen. Groei met Bosch mee. De organisatie ontwikkelt zich en jij krijgt de ruimte om daarin mee te groeien. Je hoeft niet alles al te beheersen. Wat wij belangrijk vinden, is dat je nieuwsgierig bent, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en wilt blijven leren.

title: Capital & Inventory Financial Analyst
description: The Capital & Inventory Controller is responsible for the financial oversight, reporting, analysis, and control of the Charleston Plant's inventory and capital assets for the VM division, ensuring accurate valuation, proper accounting treatment, and compliance with company policies and IFRS. Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, the Controller provides financial insights and analysis that support effective asset management, strong internal controls, operational performance, and informed business decisions. Drive continuous improvement in capital planning, reporting, and internal control processes while supporting audit requirements and ensuring compliance with corporate governance standards. Partner with Supply Chain and Operations teams to improve inventory accuracy, optimize working capital, and support operational planning and decision-making. Experience working with ERP and reporting systems such as SAP, Hyperion Essbase, etc Core Competencies Financial analysis and business acumen. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Project management and organizational effectiveness. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Continuous improvement mindset. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong attention to detail and commitment to financial accuracy. Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive results through collaboration.

The position will also interface with European headquarters and lead plants, supporting legal entity reporting requirements and serving as a key financial partner to internal customers. The Plant Controller will lead and develop a highly motivated finance team, building strong business partners aligned to value streams and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making. This role plays a critical part in shaping financial performance through proactive analysis, forecasting, and identification of risks and opportunities across the plant. Lead long-term financial scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to assess profitability, evaluate strategic decisions, and support sustainable plant performance. Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing plant finance team, fostering strong business partnership with operations and building a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.Lead the development of annual budgets and financial forecasts, providing clear insight into cost structures, capital investment needs, and key business drivers. Preferred Post-Graduate Degree Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or related field Special License/Certification CMA or CPA certification Required Knowledge, Skills, Ability, Training, Experience, etc. Advanced expertise in cost accounting, financial analysis, and manufacturing finance principles. Strong proficiency in ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced Excel for financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build strong relationships across all levels of the organization. Results-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, able to translate data into actionable insights. Solid understanding of financial regulations, internal controls, and accounting best practices. Proven leadership capability, with experience developing, mentoring, and building high-performing teams. Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, balancing hands-on execution with forward-looking financial planning and decision support.

title: Finance Business Partner - Energy Transition Finance Team
description: Location: Copenhagen, Denmark At Maersk, we're working to enable the transition towards net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2040. We're looking for a Finance Business Partner to join our Energy Transition Finance team and help support the financial decisions that will shape the future of sustainable shipping. This is not a traditional finance partnering role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, energy markets, green fuels, regulation, and business transformation, partnering with stakeholders across our commercial, trading, origination, operational, and finance communities. What you'll be doing In this role, you'll provide financial insights and decision support across Maersk's green fuel activities. You'll help evaluate opportunities, assess risks, and ensure we make informed decisions as we scale our decarbonization efforts. Your responsibilities will include: Driving performance management, reporting, forecasting, and planning activities Conducting financial, scenario, and sensitivity analyses to support business decisions Supporting financial due diligence for fuel supply agreements and new products Helping stakeholders understand the financial implications of evolving fuel markets and regulations Identifying opportunities to improve reporting, processes, and automation Building strong partnerships across Energy Transition, Energy Markets, and Finance teams Supporting the development of sustainable financial processes for emerging fuels and regulatory requirements Who we're looking for We're seeking someone with strong analytical and business partnering skills, combined with a genuine interest in the energy transition landscape. You may already have experience within energy, fuels, commodities, trading, renewables, sustainability, or a related sector. Equally, you may bring strong finance experience and a track record of quickly building expertise in complex and evolving subject areas. We're particularly interested in candidates who bring: Experience in finance business partnering, commercial finance, FP&A, product control, risk, or a similar analytical role Strong financial modelling and analytical capabilities Experience working with data and tools such as Excel and Power BI The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and influence a diverse range of stakeholders A proactive, curious, and solutions-oriented mindset Comfort navigating ambiguity and solving problems in a fast-changing environment ** Experience within energy markets, fuels, commodities, decarbonization, sustainability, or related industries will be a significant advantage. title: Product Controller
description: Product Controller – Commodities & Energy Trading Risk & Product Control | Maersk Oil Trading | Copenhagen Opportunity (On-Site) ​ At Maersk, we are rethinking how energy is traded, managed and consumed across our global operations. Maersk Oil Trading manages an expanding portfolio of marine fuels, distillates, crude, and emerging low-carbon alternatives such as methanol, LNG and biofuels, traded across Copenhagen, Singapore and the Americas. The Product Control team is the custodian of traded P&L, providing transparency over trading economics, market exposures and performance drivers. We are looking for a Product Controller to join our Copenhagen team and take ownership of a range of activities spanning daily P&L, valuations, exposure reporting and business partnering with the trading desks. This role is ideal for someone with a a couple of years’ foundation in Product Control, Market Risk or a similar trading support function who is ready to deepen their expertise in commodity trading. You will join a highly experienced team, gain direct exposure to physical and derivative trading, and have the opportunity to broaden across products, regions and a rapidly evolving energy landscape. ** While experience within energy markets is advantageous, we are equally interested in candidates from other commodity sectors or trading environments who bring strong technical fundamentals, curiosity and a desire to learn . Key Responsibilities Daily P&L and Exposure Control Produce and validate daily trading P&L across physical and derivative positions in fuel oil, gasoil, crude and alternative fuels. Perform detailed P&L attribution, analysing and explaining key performance drivers and market movements. Prepare and review daily position and exposure reports, ensuring accuracy and alignment with trading activity. Communicate P&L and exposure insights clearly to traders, Risk and management. Valuation and Market Assurance Apply and validate forward curves, spreads and differentials used in the valuation of trading positions. Support accurate mark-to-market valuation of physical and derivative portfolios. Perform independent price verification (IPV) and support month-end valuation activities. Contribute to valuation approaches across both established and emerging fuel products. Operations Supervisor - Distribution

  • Foster an environment of open communication and collaboration, facilitating regular and effective dialogue among leadership and associates to promote transparency, alignment, and teamwork.


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, preferred.
  • 1+ years operations experience in a lead/supervisor/management role, preferred.
  • 1+ years logistics industry experience, preferred.
  • Staff management, workload planning, objective setting and organizational skills, preferred.

Our Organization has a business casual environment and focuses on teamwork, associate development, training, and continuous improvement.

description:
The Business Data Analyst II role has a national salary range of $55,000 - $90,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $90,000, Washington is $80,169 - $90,000, New York is 62,354 - $90,000 and Colorado 57,500 - $90,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.


Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst II who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!


Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst II, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that improve performance, reduce costs, and enhance service levels. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders across operations to develop models, dashboards, and reports that guide decision-making and drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)


Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 0–2 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, preferred
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, preferred
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required

By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone. AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances. We are in an increasingly busy restructuring market and our Turnaround & Restructuring Services practice has ambitious growth plans - this has created opportunities for individuals from a range of backgrounds. Composed of the most respected financial restructuring professionals in the industry, AlixPartners is widely recognised for its long and successful record in helping its clients resolve urgent situations and implement rapid change. We have deep expertise across the entire turnaround lifecycle, with our three main service offerings being: Company Advisory and Interim Management: Working closely with management teams to quickly stabilise crisis situations, protect their position and that of other investors, and deliver optimal outcomes. Our hands-on approach addresses challenges quickly - allowing us to turn around companies who are facing financial and operational challenges through a range of levers that support short-term and long-term ambitions and outcomes for organisations. Creditor Advisory: We rapidly assess situations, working closely with creditors and the management teams of their borrowers to review performance and develop strategies to protect creditors’ positions and deliver optimal outcomes in the most stressed and distressed situations. We have a breadth of knowledge dealing with cash, liquidity, strategy, refinancing and negotiation situations, getting to solutions fast, and implementing solutions through experience. Contingency Planning & Insolvency: We work closely with clients to preserve value by implementing solutions using formal UK and international restructuring tools and most importantly, our practical expertise. We excel in complex distressed situations, often involving multiple jurisdictions and diverse stakeholder groups. What you’ll do We now have opportunities in London for SVPs who have experience working for clients in one of more of the above areas. SVPs are senior Project Managers in our structure and are seen as the future leaders of AlixPartners. We are looking for a smart, pragmatic and results-focused individual who can operate on a range of UK based and international engagements. We are keen to attract individuals who can contribute to AlixPartners’ enviable reputation for driving positive change for the immediate and long-term success of our clients. SVPs lead commercially successful engagements in a ‘hands-on’, professional and energetic manner. They collaborate with colleagues across the world as well as engage with, and promote, the firm’s broader capabilities. What you’ll need Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following: Ideally between 7-10 years of experience in a similar role or environment.* Relevant and hands-on project management experience in restructuring gained in restructuring advisory, consulting, private equity, banking or industry. University degree or relevant school-leaver-programme experience, ideally as well as a post graduate qualification (e.g. ACA/ACCA) Demonstrable experience in some of the following situations is essential: Financial turnaround programmes Cash and working capital management Building, reviewing and maintaining short term cash flow models Formulating, reviewing and analysing business plans and financial forecasts Supporting Chief Restructuring Officer roles Balance sheet restructurings Options analysis Contingency planning Schemes of Arrangements / Restructuring Plans Trading Administrations Insolvency case management and progression Indepe

KGaA, Munich (www.mutares.com), as a listed private equity holding company, acquires medium-sized companies in special situations, which show significant operational improvement potential and are sold again after undergoing a repositioning and stabilization process. Mutares actively support its portfolio companies with its own investment and operations teams and through strategic add-on acquisitions. The focus is on companies with revenues ranging from EUR 100 million to EUR 750 million, across various industries. The aim is to achieve a clear value increase with a focus on sustainable, long-term growth of the portfolio company.

Your Tasks

  • Manage the restructuring and improvement processes for our portfolio companies on-site to implement and improve sound cash management processes on-site

  • Partner closely with the Mutares restructuring team by conducting financial analyses, developing and integrating financial models, and critically evaluating business cases

  • Prepare and execute financing solutions (factoring, asset-based funding, credit lines)

  • Improve financial statement closing and other finance/controlling processes and assist in the preparation of financial statements and audit

  • Manage the relationship with external stakeholders (auditors, financial advisers, banks, credit insurers, etc.)

Your Profile

  • Successfully completed a Finance degree with outstanding results

  • At least 6 years of experience in a Big4/Management Consulting firm (preferably restructuring focused) or Controlling/Finance department of an industry firm (preferably with exposure to restructuring situation)

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Integrated financial modelling and cash forecasts)

  • Business fluency in Polish and English with the ability to communicate in a well-structured and concise manner

  • Willingness to travel up to 4 days per week (typically Monday – Thursday) and to work in an international environment

What Mutares offers

  • Work in a highly motivated, international, committed, and agile team that enjoys working together

  • Exciting work environment with varied challenges, strategic influence, and tasks for continuous personal and professional development

  • Flat hierarchies, fast decision-making processes, and room for your own ideas

  • Regular team events and offsites

title: IT Architect – Energy Business
description: Are you ready to take on the challenge of shaping the future of energy assets? As an IT Architect - at Vattenfall, you will play a pivotal role in driving our mission of achieving fossil free living within one generation. By optimizing and innovating our IT landscape, you will contribute to increasing efficiency and sustainably. Your expertise will contribute to a smarter, more resilient energy system, making a real impact on the environment. What will you do? You will become part of a central and internationally operating IT hub of IT Architects, where each individual has a focus on a specific part of our energy business. You will play a crucial role in steering our strategic projects to successful execution through fit-for-purpose architecture. Your responsibilities will include consulting, supporting and educating the business on IT, integration, and data strategies. With your solid understanding of IT security, you will support our mission critical environment in the evolving and changing business we are operating in. You will build up business knowledge to become the go-to expert for advancing our IT landscape. In this role, you will: Guide strategic projects to successful execution with fit-for-purpose architecture Consult and educate the business on IT, integration, and data strategies Support in adopting secure IT practices Drive the adoption of data mesh in collaboration with the business Help grow our Enterprise thinking and establish standards and architecture principles Act as a trusted advisor, enabling operating models through technology, even if it requires radical change By fostering strong interactions with internal and external stakeholders, you will help shape the future of our IT landscape. Your ability to translate complex challenges into actionable insights will inspire your colleagues and drive the continuous improvement of our operations. Location Luleå or Stockholm Who are you You are an experienced professional with a strong background in IT architecture, ideally with a business focus on asset-intensive industries such as Energy, Water, Industry, or Automotive. With at least 10+ years of relevant experience, you bring a deep understanding of IT security, integration topics, and data strategies. Your academic degree in IT or a related field has equipped you with the theoretical knowledge, while your practical experience has honed your skills in implementing fit-for-purpose architectures. You have successfully navigated the complexities of international environments. Your ability to communicate effectively with both IT and non-IT colleagues at various levels within the organization sets you apart. You thrive in dynamic, ever-changing environments and are adept at translating complex problems into actionable insights for the Management Board. Key qualifications we are looking for: Extensive experience as an Architect or Consultant Deep IT knowledge and experience with IT architecture and frameworks Comfortable communicating complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences Ability to thrive in an ever-changing environment and direct complex problems into concise actions for leadership Your ability to build trust and drive change will be essential in this role, as you help shape the future of our business through innovative IT solutions.

title: (Senior) Business Controller
description: We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated (Senior) Business Controller to join our team in Berlin on a two-year fixed-term contract . The Senior Business Controller position will support the Director and the department of Sales & Operation Germany (S&O GER), within the BU E-Mobility, with all business controlling tasks including month-end close preparation and reporting, plan-to-perform (business plan, forecast and KPIs follow-up) processes and ad-hoc financial analysis. Additionally, with your local controlling expertise, you will serve as an advisor towards the BU Controller of E-Mobility in specific or over-arching BU controlling topics. Key responsibilities & activities: Responsible for all business controlling topics concerning E-Mobility departments in S&O GER including but not limited to: Ensure the accuracy of the P&L structure ensuring financial data is correctly booked and aligned Drive month-end close through accrual preparation and coordination with accounting on key topics Prepare monthly management reporting, delivering clear insights on financial performance Actively participate in the S&O GER MT meetings by acting as a financial partner, challenging and supporting with business decisions Prepare financial forecasts by translating business input into accurate, forward-looking financials Lead the local business plan process together with local Management Team, ensuring alignment of financial goals Support in preparation and monitoring of KPIs to track business performance Support the local unit’s growth by advising on financial aspects of new initiatives, improvements and other strategic decisions As advisor to BU Controller you support and challenge BU controlling governance and run specific initiatives or ad-hoc analysis As (Senior) Business Controller E-Mobility you report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility who is accountable for the overall controlling support of the Business unit. Location : Berlin Your profile and soft skills: Ideal candidate has 5+ years of experience within Business Controlling, Financial Analysis or Commercial Project Management Bachelor’s and ideally Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or similar education You are a team player and natural networker with experience from working in a challenging and high-paced business environment You have proven ability to establish trust and build relationships You are proactive, constructive and solution oriented You have strong excel and presentation skills, SAP experience You have high analytical skills with an eye for details Experience from utility business is a strong merit Full professional fluency in English and German is required

title: Commercial Manager (18-month temporary position)
description: As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. We are looking for a Commercial Manager to join our Commercial Operations team on a temporary full-time basis for 18 months . In this role, you will have end-to-end commercial responsibility for assigned offshore wind assets in Germany. Acting as the key commercial partner to Site Management, you will manage a broad range of operational contracts, drive commercial performance, and ensure contractual risks and opportunities are effectively managed. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Asset Management, and external suppliers, you will help create commercial value, support efficient operations, and contribute to continuous improvement across the assets. What will you do? Commercial Management Partner with Site Management on commercial, contractual, and financial matters. Provide commercial analysis and recommendations to support operational and strategic decisions. Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities. Support budgeting, forecasting, and performance reviews. Lead or support commercial negotiations and contract-related discussions. Contract Management Manage operational contracts throughout their lifecycle. Monitor supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations. Handle contract variations, claims, and commercial disputes where required. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and key internal stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Drive improvements to commercial processes, reporting, and ways of working. Identify and implement value-creation and cost-saving opportunities. Promote best practices and share lessons learned across assets and functions. Who are you? You are a commercially driven professional with experience in contract and supplier management within a complex operational environment. You combine strong analytical skills with a pragmatic mindset and are comfortable working with both commercial details and broader business objectives. You build strong relationships, communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, and take ownership of delivering results. Structured and proactive by nature, you thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift and no two days are the same. Next to this you bring: A degree in a commercial, legal, engineering or similar discipline Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract, commercial or procurement roles — preferably in renewables, energy, oil & gas, or other complex industries Experience interpreting, managing, supporting and negotiating commercial agreements supported by a strong commercial mindset Experience with operational renewable energy assets Ability to manage many tasks simultaneously with structure and prioritization Experience working with suppliers and external stakeholders Must be able to manage and negotiate contracts in English German language is a plus, not a must Location: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Kolding or Copenhagen (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or London (UK)

title: Financial Business Partner / Business Controller
description: Som Financial Business Partner har du en central roll i att stödja och utmana verksamheten i både operativa och strategiska frågor. Du arbetar nära ledningsgruppen inom ditt ansvarsområde och bidrar med finansiella insikter som skapar förutsättningar för välgrundade affärsbeslut och långsiktig värdeskapande utveckling. I rollen ansvarar du bland annat för att driva och samordna budget- och prognosprocesser samt säkerställer hög kvalitet och träffsäkerhet i verksamhetens ekonomiska planering. Genom att analysera resultat, identifiera trender, risker och möjligheter samt omsätta finansiell data till konkreta rekommendationer bidrar du till välgrundade beslut som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du följer upp mål, nyckeltal och prestationer för att säkerställa att verksamheten utvecklas i linje med uppsatta ambitioner. Du fungerar som en proaktiv affärspartner som stöttar, vägleder och utmanar chefer i ekonomiska och affärsmässiga frågor, samtidigt som du bidrar till att driva verksamheten framåt. Ditt arbete präglas av nära samarbete med verksamheten där du förväntas bidra med både perspektiv, initiativkraft och affärsmässighet. Som medlem i ledningsgruppen för ditt område har du en aktiv roll och bidrar med ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv. Du är trygg i att presentera ekonomiska analyser och rekommendationer för seniora beslutsfattare och har förmågan att göra komplex information tydlig och relevant. Du blir en del av ett engagerat controllerteam som präglas av ett öppet och prestigelöst arbetssätt där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och olika perspektiv bidrar till både individuellt lärande och gemensamma resultat. Vi söker dig som har Akademisk examen inom ekonomi eller motsvarande Minst 5 års erfarenhet i rollen som Financial Business Partner, Business Controlling eller annan kvalificerad ekonomistyrning Jobbat nära ledningsgrupper och stöttat beslutsfattande genom finansiell analys och affärsmässig rådgivning Erfarenhet av att driva budget-, prognos- och uppföljningsprocesser Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och PowerPoint Som person är du analytisk och datadriven med förmåga att växla mellan helhetsperspektiv och detaljer. Du är affärsorienterad, strategisk och trivs med att omsätta analyser till konkreta rekommendationer som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du bygger förtroende genom ett prestigelöst arbetssätt, god samarbetsförmåga och positiv energi. Du har lätt för att bygga relationer och är trygg i att presentera dina slutsatser, samtidigt som du är lyhörd för verksamhetens behov. Vi söker framför allt en nyfiken och engagerad person som vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten. Om du dessutom har ett intresse för system, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling kommer du att trivas hos oss, särskilt då vi befinner oss i en spännande förändringsresa med implementeringen av SAP S/4HANA.

title: Senior Commercial & Contract Manager - Offshore Wind
description: Do you want to shape the commercial performance of one of Europe's largest offshore wind portfolios? At Vattenfall, there is a way. We are accelerating the transition towards a future powered by renewable energy. Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms onshore and offshore across Europe. With more than 24 GW of offshore wind projects in development and a growing operational portfolio, this is your opportunity to influence the future of sustainable energy at scale. We are looking for a Senior Commercial & Contract Manager Offshore Wind to join our Commercial Operations team. In this position, you will play a leading role in protecting and creating value across Vattenfall's offshore wind assets. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will drive strategic commercial initiatives, lead high-impact negotiations and contribute to the development of commercial excellence across Offshore Wind Operations. You will operate at the intersection of Operations, Asset Management, Procurement, Legal, Finance and Engineering, helping to solve complex commercial challenges while strengthening the commercial maturity of the organisation. What will you do? As Senior Commercial & Contract Manager, you will provide commercial leadership across a portfolio of operational offshore wind assets and support the continuous development of commercial governance and best practices throughout Offshore Wind Operations. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring that major supplier relationships, contractual frameworks and commercial decisions contribute to safe, reliable and cost-efficient operations. Your main tasks and responsibilities: Act as the senior commercial and contractual partner for assigned offshore wind assets, supporting critical operational and strategic business decisions. Lead the commercial management of a portfolio of high-value operational contracts, ensuring performance, contractual compliance, risk mitigation, and value delivery throughout the contract lifecycle. Lead complex commercial negotiations, major contract amendments, claims, disputes, and other high-impact contractual matters with strategic suppliers and contractors. Drive commercial performance by identifying opportunities to improve contract outcomes, reduce lifecycle costs, manage risk, and strengthen supplier collaboration across the portfolio. Provide clear commercial, contractual, and financial recommendations that support robust decision-making and long-term asset value creation. Shape and continuously improve commercial governance, contract management standards, reporting, and best practices across Offshore Wind Operations. Coach and support commercial colleagues while acting as a subject matter expert for complex commercial and contractual issues across the business. Who are you? You are an experienced commercial professional who combines strong commercial judgement with the ability to influence complex business decisions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing stakeholder interests and managing high-impact contractual matters in a large-scale operational environment. You enjoy working across functions and are recognised for your ability to build trust, challenge constructively and create sustainable business value. Next to this you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Law, Engineering, or a related discipline. Extensive experience in contract management, commercial management, procurement, supplier management, or a comparable commercial discipline. Proven success leading complex commercial negotiations and managing high-value supplier and service agreements within asset-intensive industries. Strong expertise in contract strategy, contract changes, claims management, dispute resolution, and commercial risk management. Experience within offshore wind, renewable energy, utilities, maritime, infrastructure, oil & gas, or other complex operational environments. The ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted relationships across functions, and translate complex commercial matters into practical business decisions. Native-level German and fluent English language skills, with the ability to lead negotiations, manage contractual discussions, and to operate effectively in an international environment. Location Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam or Kolding.

title: Developer & Business Analyst - Trading Systems
description: We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office with P&L reporting and price risk management down to invoicing and for whichever commodity we are trading: electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. title: Operations Specialist at Volvo Financial Services (maternity cover)
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. You will: Participate in financing processes of trucks, buses, construction equipment and related services Administer new and existing leasing contracts, including initiation, activation, modifications and terminations Address customer and dealer inquiries, resolving them directly or coordinating with appropriate departments Collaborate cross-functionally to support and develop smooth and efficient operational processes Who are you? Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. If you: have experience in customer service and contract administration, particularly in the financial service industry have knowledge of leasing products and services have great interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills in Lithuanian and English are able to work independently and as part of a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment have exceptional attention to detail and strong time management skills have a proficiency in Microsoft Office have a university degree, ideally in finance or business administration What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. Salary level: from 2.000€ to 2.600€ per month gross (before withholding taxes) depending on skills and experience. Also, annual bonus program will be applied in accordance with the Company policy. Ready for the next move? Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today! We are looking forward to your CV and motivation letter in English. For further information, please contact: Vilma Suchockiene, People & Culture Manager Mob. +370 686 77016; email: vilma.suchockiene@volvo.com We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. At Volvo Financial Services , we are working together to shape the world we want to live in. As the captive finance arm of the Volvo Group, VFS provides financial services and solutions that meet the needs of our customers’ evolving business. Through our dedication to innovation, we support society in its adoption of sustainable transport and equipment solutions. VFS is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and serves Volvo Group customers and dealers in more than 50 markets. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid and competitive package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy a diverse working environment with a culture of care and inclusion. As an investment, we support your personal development and growth to achieve your career aspirations. Volvo Financial Services is an on-site business and we understand that you might need occasional or temporary flexibility, which your leader is equipped to manage and fits well to our culture, as being together enables us to build upon our innovative and collaborative culture, as well as develop you for continued success.

title: Actuaire (H/F)
description: Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement réactif et en plein développement où vous pourrez mettre en valeur vos compétences techniques et vos qualités relationnelles : vous êtes prêt pour un nouveau challenge ! Zurich France, entreprise appartenant à un groupe international de premier ordre, offre aux sociétés des solutions sur mesure et des concepts d’assurance innovants pour le transfert, le financement et la gestion de leurs risques. Nous sommes convaincus que notre développement et nos succès passent par ceux de nos collaborateurs : Formation, évolution de carrière, mobilité internationale sont une réalité pour chacun d’entre nous. Nous recherchons pour notre équipe Finance un Actuaire (H/F). Votre rôle Rattaché(e) au Responsable Actuariat, vous intervenez au cœur de l’écosystème Zurich France (Direction Générale, Souscription, Finance, Sinistres) et en lien étroit avec les équipes d’actuariat du Groupe (Reserving & Pricing). Vous êtes un partenaire clé des souscripteurs et des responsables de branches, avec une contribution directe à la qualité des décisions de tarification et de pilotage. Les principales activités seront les suivantes : Pilotage des outils de tarification : Vous testez, challengez et faites évoluer les outils de tarification groupe, en adaptant les paramètres à la réalité de l’entité française. Vous êtes le point de contact en France sur ces sujets, accompagnez les souscripteurs dans leurs demandes spécifiques et animez des sessions de formation pour diffuser les bonnes pratiques de pricing. Analyse du portefeuille et de la sinistralité : Vous analysez le portefeuille et sa sinistralité sur l’ensemble des branches souscrites en France. Vous produisez des analyses détaillées par branche afin d’identifier les leviers d’optimisation (rentabilité, qualité des risques, tendances de sinistres) en étroite collaboration avec les souscripteurs, responsables de branches et équipes sinistres. Clôtures actuarielles trimestrielles et reportings : Vous coordonnez le processus de clôtures actuarielles (reserving), en lien avec les équipes de contrôle de gestion en France et à l’étranger. Vous assurez la mise à jour et le développement des reportings actuariels, en veillant à la cohérence avec les standards du Groupe et aux besoins locaux de pilotage. Tarification des affaires complexes et facilités / MGA : Vous intervenez sur les dossiers à forte complexité technique, en proposant des tarifications adaptées et robustes. Vous réalisez des études spécifiques pour éclairer les décisions de souscription sur les comptes complexes et les facilités / MGA, en apportant une expertise actuarielle reconnue. Data, automatisation et innovation : Vous contribuez à l’optimisation des reportings locaux et des outils d’analyse en utilisant des langages comme R, Python, etc., ainsi que des solutions d’intelligence artificielle. Vous êtes force de proposition pour moderniser nos pratiques d’exploitation de la donnée et faciliter le suivi de l’activité. Votre profil : Diplôme bac +5 en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées financières ou actuariat 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en actuariat, idéalement en assurance IARD ou entreprise Maîtrise des outils de tarification et des outils informatiques Très bonne maîtrise d’Excel (dont VBA) Connaissance des langages R, Python ou équivalent (logique de programmation) À l’aise avec le traitement et l’analyse de données chiffrées Solides bases en assurance et compréhension des enjeux techniques Anglais courant pour les échanges avec les équipes du Groupe Savoir-être : Esprit de synthèse, rigueur et fiabilité dans vos analyses Capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives Esprit d’équipe, sens du service et envie de partager vos bonnes pratiques Excellente aisance relationnelle, en interne comme en externe Sens des responsabilités et forte adaptabilité dans un environnement international Rémunération : Entre 48K€ et 58K€ Vous pensez que vous êtes fait pour ce poste ? Faites-nous vite parvenir votre candidature en répondant directement via l’annonce ou sur notre site internet. Le poste est basé à Paris. Prises ensemble, la diversité et l’inclusion nous rapprochent de notre objectif commun : dépasser les attentes de nos clients. Zurich applique une politique d'égalité des chances dans l'emploi. title: Actuarial Analyst
description: ¡Hola! Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. CI/CD & Automation ▪ Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for Scala-based data applications. ▪ Automate build, packaging, and deployment processes (e.g., SBT, github enterprise). ▪ Enforce DevSecOps practices, including secure pipeline design and infrastructure governance. Data Platform Enablement ▪ Enable reliable runtime execution of production data pipelines and ensure SLA adherence. ▪ Collaborate with engineers to resolve performance bottlenecks and deployment issues. ▪ Support environment transitions, and platform lifecycle processes. Platform Optimization ▪ Optimize resource utilization, scalability, and cost-efficiency across platform components. ▪ Provide transparency into platform usage, cost drivers, and optimization opportunities. Qualifications ▪ Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. ▪ Minimum 5 years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a strong focus on automation and infrastructure engineering. ▪ Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines. ▪ Experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms and pipeline ecosystems (Scala / Spark environments). ▪ Strong understanding of distributed systems, reliability engineering, and observability practices. ▪ Experience with Databricks platform operations and Spark workload optimization. ▪ Experience integrating build and deployment pipelines (e.g., SBT, github enterprise). ▪ Experience with Power BI service administration and enterprise gateway architectures is a plus. ▪ Strong focus on automation-first approaches with minimal reliance on manual operations. ▪ Ability to work across global teams and collaborate with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders. NOT a Fit If Your Experience Is Primarily ▪ Manual system or platform administration without automation or Infrastructure-as-Code ▪ Ticket-based operations or L2/L3 support roles ▪ BI/reporting-focused roles or Power BI-only administration

Deep, hands‑on experience with UDP multicast in production environments, including loss, recovery, and operational behavior. Strong understanding of low‑latency techniques, including NUMA, core pinning / CPU isolation, IRQ affinity, kernel and network tuning, memory management, and cache locality. Production experience using Aeron, including transport/driver tuning, back‑pressure management, loss/replay semantics, and performance diagnostics. description:
Nu tar vi nästa steg inom försäkring och pension och förstärker med en ny roll som försäkringsrådgivare. Du blir en del av vårt team med försäkringsspecialister och får vara med och utveckla försäkringsaffären vidare. Här kombinerar du din kompetens med affärsdriv och förmågan att få både kunder och kollegor att lyckas.

Du arbetar proaktivt med rådgivning inom försäkring och pension och utvecklar långsiktiga kundrelationer. Genom att förstå kundens situation, behov och mål hittar du relevanta lösningar och ser nya affärsmöjligheter.

Men jobbet handlar inte bara om din egen affär. Du arbetar nära våra rådgivare och kontor, delar med dig av din kompetens och hjälper andra att se och ta vara på möjligheter hos sina kunder. Tillsammans skapar ni bättre kundmöten och utvecklar affären.

Rollen innebär bland annat att du:

· Ger rådgivning inom försäkring och pension.

· Arbetar proaktivt med befintliga kunder och nya affärsmöjligheter.

· Stöttar rådgivare i kunddialogen och bidrar till att utveckla deras affär.

· Delar kunskap och stärker kompetensen inom området.

· Bygger starka relationer med både kunder och kollegor.

· Bidrar till att utveckla försäkringsaffären och nå våra gemensamma mål.

Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som kan försäkring och pension och som gillar att skapa affärer tillsammans med andra. Du tar initiativ, skapar förtroende och har lätt för att bygga relationer både internt och externt.

Du ser möjligheter, delar med dig av det du kan, och tycker att det är lika viktigt att lyfta andras framgångar som att lyckas med din egen. Har du erfarenhet av en liknande roll i en annan bank ser vi det som en stor fördel.

Du ska ha Swedsec rådgivarlicens och erfarenhet inom försäkringsförmedling är meriterande.

Vilka vi är
Du blir en del av Private Banking, där vi möter kunder med komplexa behov och som ställer höga krav på rådgivningen.

På Sparbanken Alingsås arbetar vi nära kunderna och nära varandra. Vi vill förstå människan bakom ekonomin, göra det komplexa enklare och använda vår kompetens för att skapa värde över tid.

Här får du möjlighet att påverka och bidra med det du kan. Tillsammans med kollegor som vill framåt är du med och utvecklar både kundmötet och vår affär.
